notes: Manifest-bound prepublication authorization seal for Open US Law sparse GraphRAG (OUL-043). Created before any public Dataset or Bucket mutation. Binds the exact OUL-040 candidate, the isolated OUL-041/OUL-042 staging revision and content-addressed bucket prefix, the environment-only principal and write scope, predecessor task/goal closure including generated refill work, authorized target IDs, the additive operation set, and a short-lived expiration. This CLI does not mutate a remote target.
